name: Matutinal-Paean

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: A culture of tide-readers who navigate the world-ocean by starlight and song.

description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in towering mountain ranges. Travelers navigate by a nearby asteroid belt and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on solar potential, titanium and biomass are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
